extracted.name: Chicken Prawn Balls
extracted.description: Chicken Prawn Balls are a delicious fusion appetizer made by combining minced chicken and prawns into flavourful bite-sized balls. This dish blends the tender juiciness of chicken with the subtle sweetness of prawns, creating a rich and savory taste. Often seasoned with garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and green onions, the mixture is shaped into small balls and then either deep-fried, baked, or steamed until golden and cooked through. They are popular in Asian cuisines and are typically served with dipping sauces like sweet chili, soy-garlic, or spicy mayo. These protein-packed bites make great starters, party snacks, or additions to noodle soups and rice bowls.
instruction_lines: Wash prawns and place in colander to drain.
In a food processor add the chicken, prawns and process until well combined.
Add egg, garlic, ginger, corn flour, flour, and spices. process to combine and remove mixture in a bowl.
Crumble the bread slices and add to the chicken-prawn mixture. Mix well to combine.
Make small balls with the mixture.
Heat oil in a deep pan over medium heat.
Deep fry balls for 10-12 minutes on medium heat until crispy and golden brown.
Remove and drain on an absorbent paper.
